$comment: The two guards shouting at each other from their watchtowers between Jatizso and Neitiznot (plane 2), from rsprox recording 3027 (rev 231) ticks 5008-5420 and 6930-7060 and local recording 1000323 (rev 227) ticks 6513-6584: five Watch-shouting clicks, each followed by the same exchange. `guards` are keyed by cache gameval: `at` is the spawn tile, `chant` what it shouts between rounds, `camera` the watcher's camera when that guard is clicked (move-to and look-at x, y, height; rate 20/50). `round` is the exchange, one line every 5 ticks, worded as the Wiki transcripts (Transcript:Guard (Jatizso watchtower)); the recordings' fifth line after a Jatizso-guard click reads "CALL THAT A TOWN? ..." (rec 3027 ticks 5032/5251/5354), a recorded difference. Docs: docs/viking-shouters.md.
round: YOU WOULDN'T KNOW HOW TO KILL A TROLL IF IT CAME UP AND BIT YER ARM OFF!
YOU WOULDN'T KNOW HOW TO SHAVE A YAK IF YOUR LIFE DEPENDED ON IT!
CALL THAT A TOWN, I'VE SEEN BETTER HAMLETS!
AND YOUR FATHER SMELLED OF WINTERBERRIES.
AT LEAST WE HAVE SOMETHING OTHER THAN SMELLY FISH!
OUR KING'S BETTER THAN YOUR BURGHER!

dialogueSteps.$comment: The generated transcripts' "Can I watch?" choice ends on an action step that continues at Watching the shouting (npc-dialogues.json, Guard (Jatizso watchtower) / Guard (Neitiznot watchtower)); it plays the same round.

timing.$comment: Ticks. The round starts `roundDelay` after the click's arrival (+3 in all five); a line every `lineInterval`. Each guard chants every `chantInterval`; chants stop for the round and resume at `chantResume` ticks after the round start (izso +56..+61, iznot +62..+66 recorded; the medians), and the watcher's camera resets at `cameraReset` (+63 in all five).
